steps.content: Under the scorching sun of Eastside, you clutch a gold foil ticket while standing at the entrance of a storefront. The sign above displays large letters in a Gothic font: Nightwrought.

The narrow pedestrian street is packed with visitors drawn by this famous place. The air is thick with excitement and anticipation, mingled with the unique exhaustion of working adults. Perfume, sweat, and food aromas blend into a dizzying urban scent that assaults your nose.

According to Faye, this is an "all-in-one sensory playground" that combines escape rooms, murder mystery games, TRPG, and immersive theater. Today, you'll plunge into its magnum opus, its signature production that has made countless guests scream, forget how to speak, or even flee in tears: <color=#fb9259>Cirrenfold</color>.

On Eastside's online forums, people are engaging in heated debates with all sorts of opinions, but most respect the "no spoilers" rule and simply urge other curious onlookers to experience it themselves.
[Flashback] Bureau Office

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Chief, you're working yourself to death! This sallow face, these dark circles, and those new wrinkles on your forehead! Look at you, you're wasting away!

She'd said the same thing 52 times now, trying to sell you some health supplements or skincare products the Supply Office needed to get rid of each time. Normally, your response was always the same, which was...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hold on, hold on, don't be so quick to refuse, Chief! What Faye is trying to sell you this time is legit! Eugene and I have both been there. It's super fun, you know, that place...

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Exactly! It's all everyone ever talks about these days...

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: "Escape the agony of real life. Dive into a world of wonder! Forget who you are and what you do. Right now, we are all residents of Cirrenfold!"
Seriously? Watching Faye's enthusiastic delivery of the line and Wynn nodding vigorously in agreement, you remained skeptical and looked toward Eugene, the most honest and trustworthy of the bunch.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Things have been going smoothly at the Bureau lately, and all the major cases have been wrapped up. Chief, why not have a day out to relax and recharge for a bit?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is it a good idea? The last time I took your bait was Belphegor. Nearly blew up the entire Eastside. You sure we won't run into another unexpected situation this time?
Faye wagged her index finger smugly, then generously pushed a ticket into your hand.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Promise you, you won't! This one is approved by multiple staff members of the Bureau. It's totally risk-free! You can rest easy, Chief!
[End of Flashback]

Normally, at this hour, you should be working at the Bureau... but unable to resist the spiel of the three, you finally pry yourself away from your office after being cooped up in the Bureau for so long.
They all went on and on about how wonderful it was, yet strangely, no one has offered to accompany you for a second visit.
This place seems to have drawn in all Eastsiders looking for some fresh thrills. Young students, elite professionals, and weary individuals like yourself stealing a respite from the daily grind.

Looking at the bustling crowd inside and outside the place, you suddenly get cold feet. Sure, getting out and relaxing is good for your mental and physical health, but you haven't seen this many people in so long that it triggers your anxiety, your introverted tendencies suddenly intensifying.
With a weary sigh, you withdraw your hand on the door. Maybe you should just go back to work instead...
Before you can act on your decision, a group of energetic college students swarming in pushes you through the entrance.

Darkness blurs the crowd's silhouettes as you blink to adjust your eyes. In the pitch-black corridor, the candelabra meant to indicate directions doesn't feel like a guiding torch, but rather like several cold eyes staring from the darkness.

The once noisy, laughing voices suddenly fall silent, as if a thick, heavy presence in the darkness has covered their mouths and noses. No one dares to breathe loudly, only pressing against each other's shoulders as they collectively move toward the end of the dark space.

Before a set of heavy carved doors, two clusters of candles burn silently on the wall. Their light reveals a masked figure wearing an impeccably tailored suit, a top hat, and pristine white gloves, looking like he has been patiently awaiting your arrival.
As he slightly raises his hand, an ominous warning written in ornate script appears on the left side of the door:
Don't you take these scenes away, or the shadows will make you pay
Another line appears on the right side:
Keep our secrets in your heart, or your tongue will rot apart
Then, he turns to you and respectfully extends his right hand, holding it suspended before you.
What does he mean by this?
The white-gloved hand elegantly wags its index finger, then points to your communication device with its screen still lit up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My device... I'm not allowed to bring it inside?

The figure nods theatrically multiple times, pointing again at the text on the doors before gently yet irresistibly taking the device from your hand and placing it into a black velvet bag. With a flick of his wrist, the bag vanishes before your eyes.
Then he points to your right shoulder, drawing everyone's attention to you.

The white-gloved fingers snap crisply beside your ear, then produce a card from your shoulder, drawing soft gasps from everyone. In the dim light, you can barely make out the face of the card: <color=#fb9259>Seven of Clubs</color>.
That's quite a show...

Following your example, the other guests obediently surrender their devices. The white-gloved figure bows slightly, extends his arm with a flourish, and the heavy, ornate doors slowly open, unveiling a dark, endless corridor.

You proceed along the single strip of light on the floor. The darkness stretches long and silent, with only the rustling of fabric breaking the stillness. The other participants vanish from your sight, leaving only a faint, solitary point of light. You slow your pace, taking each step with utmost caution.

At the end of the corridor, you finally see candlelight. The soft glow outlines a door and illuminates the number on it. You stop before door number <color=#fb9259>7</color>, your knuckles touching the cold surface as you gently push it open.
[Scene Change] Hot spring inn, with a creaking sound
You push open the door to find an interior more spacious than you expected.
In the center lies a sunken circular stone bath, its bottom lined with smooth pebbles but containing no water, resembling a huge, hollow, and silent eye.

A subtle fragrance drifts through the air, mingling with the more pronounced scent of burning wax. Small candles dot the edges of the bath, their flames flickering and casting hazy shadows all over the room.
Faye never mentioned anything about <color=#fb9259>sitting in a hot spring bath</color> with complete strangers...?
Your body immediately tenses up as your eyes stiffly scan the faces of the other participants, only to find their expressions completely unfazed.
A girl, whom you think is one of the students you saw at the entrance, giggles suddenly, waving to get your attention.

steps.speaker: Lively Girl
steps.content: Relax! We're not really going to take a bath here. It's just for the vibe. Wash away the dust of the past. Enter the misty town of mystery. We're about to step into an ultra-realistic ancient village famous for its horrifying supernatural legends!
...Taking a dry bath together is a vibe? You're clearly behind on Eastside's latest trends.

Despite yourself, you dutifully step into the bath and sit in the empty spot the girl indicates with a tap, settling into this waterless hot spring as you try hard to appreciate Eastside's trendy "immersive experience."
To your relief, you're not the only one feeling uncomfortable here.
In this modest, empty bath, two other people sit facing each other: a young man in an ill-fitting suit with a nervous gaze, and a burly guy in work clothes who appears somewhat sheepish.

steps.speaker: Lively Girl
steps.content: Since they put us in the same room, we might end up as a team! Let's introduce ourselves. I'm <color=#fb9259>Eleanor</color>, freshman at Eastside University! What about you all?

steps.speaker: Burly Man
steps.content: Huh? Uh... j-just call me <color=#fb9259>Clay</color>.
Eleanor's greeting is certainly friendly, but the man jolts like a big cat whose tail has been stepped on, which in turn renders the girl somewhat apologetic.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Oh... did I startle you? My bad, my bad. I thought you were the tough guy type. I was hoping you'd look out for me later. Don't tell me that big guy exterior hides a more delicate soul than mine?

steps.speaker: Clay
steps.content: Um... Ahem...
He clears his throat twice as if to hide his discomfort, then shrinks further into himself. As a result, Eleanor's laughter echoes throughout the small hot spring room awkwardly.
She fake-coughs as well, composes herself, then turns her attention to the next person.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: What about you?
The person being addressed raises his head slightly, but the reflective glasses conceal his eyes. You can't discern any reaction from him, only hearing a barely audible response.

steps.speaker: Man with Glasses
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=24>Ezra Hale</size></color>.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Kazra?
"Kazra" doesn't seem bothered, nor does he try to correct her. He simply smiles, an entirely business-like smile that's polite and doesn't stir up surprise.

steps.speaker: Man with Glasses
steps.content: Or you could just call me "Glasses." It's easier that way.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: "Glasses," huh... got it.

Then Glasses's mouth is sealed shut once again. Eleanor's boundless enthusiasm is met with empty silence. With no one to catch it, it pitifully falls to the ground, where it flutters weakly a couple times—until she discovers you. Lucky you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just an ordinary Eastside citizen.
You dutifully answer before Eleanor can raise her voice. Best not to ruin her mood.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Huh? Oh, uh, okay, that's a weird name...

You exchange a few more awkward nods and murmurs and consider the introductions done. But no one tries to get the conversation going this time. The air has grown stiff, the soft crackling of burning candles the only sound in the room.
That cringeworthy awkwardness unique to modern society, especially when strangers are forced to share a confined space, permeates the room.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Is it just me, or is it getting hot in here? Haha...

The silence grows so heavy that even Eleanor begins to feel uncomfortable. Ezra tries to minimize his presence by making himself even smaller. The big guy shows no curiosity about the surroundings, sitting ramrod straight, waiting for something.
As for you, finally free from your official duties, you stare blankly at the patterns on the ceiling, mind completely empty. Perhaps due to the oxygen-depleting candle flames, you're growing drowsy.
Just as Eleanor opens her mouth, searching for a new topic, the candles suddenly go out. In the silence, only the faint scent of smoke from the snuffed wicks remains.
[Add Special Effects, Black Screen Transition] Add wind sounds, heartbeat sounds, and heavy breathing
Darkness. Not the ordinary kind that your eyes can adjust to. This pure pitch black is so thick it can swallow everything whole.

steps.speaker: Man with Glasses
steps.content: ...Here we go.
Your drowsiness vanishes instantly in the sudden darkness, replaced by an instinctive vigilance snapping awake within you.

steps.speaker: Clay
steps.content: I-it's okay. This is just part of the "game." Everyone is still here...
His voice is soft, not from fear, but sounding like a timid person trying to be encouraging. Somehow, you find yourself comforted, growing calm as you wait.

In the darkness, something is indeed slowly gathering. A dot, then another... Pale blue lights emerge silently, like sparse stars in the night sky, gradually forming a hazy constellation of luminous spots.
The air around you warms up as time seems to nearly stop. Your body has never felt so light, even the fabric of your clothes is becoming weightless...
Your thoughts come to a standstill. All the tense wrinkles of your brain seem to have been smoothed away by an invisible, gentle hand. An unfamiliar, blank tranquility washes over you.
[Background Change]
Then... you hear a voice, not through your ears, but inside your skull. The soft voice caresses your nerve endings with an inhuman tenderness that makes you shiver.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: Voyagers from distant lands, have you ever heard of such a place?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: A lost fragment in time, a neverland that can end all banality in life...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: In this place, <color=#fb9259>she</color> will respond to your whispered secrets, and the hands of time will turn in accordance with your choices.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: Welcome... to <color=#fb9259>Cirrenfold</color>.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Voice
steps.content: Tonight, you are no mere audience of the story. You... are the story.

With this mysterious voice, you hear the sound of water drawing near as vapor swirls around you. In a daze, you suddenly feel water rising up your body. From the soles of your feet to your ankles, calves, and waist. Yet when you look down, there's nothing but faint white mist.

The sound of water grows closer in the mist, gently yet irresistibly veiling your vision. In the swirling vapor, everything blurs. Your identities, along with your clothes, lift softly into the mist and slowly dissolve...
